feeds.title: Ausjazz Blog
feeds.description: Roger Mitchell has been a journalist for most of his working life, but recently completed almost two years as a senior communications adviser at Fair Work Australia before returning to the media trade as a sub-editor for AAP's Page masters. He created this blog in part because opportunities to have jazz articles appear in print these days are often limited by space restrictions. He likes to post some photographs and thoughts he is unable to make available in print about live gigs, including such major festivals.

feeds.title: Australian Jazz Museum
feeds.description: Founded in 1996, The Australian Jazz Museum mission is to proactively collect, archive and disseminate Australian jazz. They are dedicated to the collection of anything related to Australian jazz, Australians playing jazz elsewhere in the world, and non-Australians playing jazz in Australia. Their collection includes Australian jazz materials from the 1920s through to the present, covering all jazz eras and all types of jazz. Read their blog articles about music, jazz, stories, and more.

feeds.title: Canberra Jazz blog
feeds.description: Canberra Jazz blog promotes modern jazz and other arts in Canberra, Australia. The blog offers articles about music, artist stories, happy returns, and more.

feeds.title: Jazz Workshop Australia Blog
feeds.description: Jazz Workshop Australia is a music school in the Sydney suburb of St Leonard's offering music lessons specializing in jazz and improvised music. Its mission is to teach jazz through building the knowledge, skills, and character required to develop and excel. They provide learning, community, and opportunity to keen students of any age, including children and young people, and musicians at any level. The blog has articles, advice, research, news about Jazz Workshop Australia.

feeds.title: Jazz Music Insititute News
feeds.description: JMI is the hub of jazz education and performance in Australia. They are committed to providing high-quality and holistic jazz education programs of an international standard, focused on performance. Their mission is to share their love for jazz music through rigorous pedagogy and excellent performance experiences that harness & inspire a supportive community, growing a wide-reaching respect and appreciation for jazz. Get all the latest in JMI news including courses, events, institute goings on and Jazz in general.

feeds.title: Stringspace Blog
feeds.description: Stringspace was established in 2003 by musician Lucie Miller. Her interest and mission are to provide extremely high-quality and vibrant musicians for events. It is an agency made up of a collective of friends who all work together for the common goal of providing extremely high-quality live music. Its musicians include scholarship and award-winning graduates who have performed in Australia's highest-profile orchestras and with its most respected dance and theatre companies. The blog covers music in detail.

feeds.title: JazzLocal32.com » Australian And Oceania Based Bands
feeds.description: Readers will find information on Australian And Oceania Based Bands, here on the blog. John Fenton is a videographer, photographer, published poet & writer. He writes the blog JazzLocal32.com. His task is to tell the musicians stories; rendering musical notes into words. He writes as a listener.
